jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.

Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource-library/customer-stories

Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
Employees receive 25 days of paid time off per year. After 5 years of employment, employees receive 30 days per year.
Appfire provides comprehensive coverage through Empire Health, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Additional protection includes life insurance, critical illness coverage, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
To promote health and well-being, Appfire offers a yearly sport allowance of CAD 600, which can be used to cover the cost of various fitness or outdoor activities from gym memberships to sports equipment.
Volunteering - Every employee receives 3 fully paid days each year to participate in Appfire Town, our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program supporting local communities.

Market recognition

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

As the Senior Director, Strategy Risk Business Operations and Shared Services you will lead a high-performing team of directors, senior managers, and managers to drive strategic, operational, and financial excellence within RBC’s Commercial & Payment Technology (CPT) portfolio. This critical leadership role is accountable for Financial Management, Project Portfolio Planning, Vendor Management, Risk & Compliance, and Strategic Planning, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and delivering exceptional business outcomes. You will champion employee engagement, change management, and innovation (e.g., AI adoption) while maintaining rigorous governance and operational excellence.

What You'll Do

Leadership & Strategy

Lead the Planning, Risk & Governance functions, overseeing financial management, project portfolio planning, and strategic alignment with RBC’s Commercial Banking and T&O objectives.
Develop and execute CPT’s 5-year strategic plan, leveraging internal/external research and partnering with business executives to drive disciplined project management.
Champion enterprise initiatives (e.g., AI/AIDLC) and change management within CPT, ensuring successful adoption and engagement.
Foster exceptional employee engagement through targeted strategies and communication plans in partnership with Enterprise Communications.

Risk & Governance

Ensure adherence to Risk & Governance policies, standards, and control points (e.g., audits, access reviews, compliance attestations).
Lead T&O and RBC-initiated Risk & Governance campaigns, collaborating with Risk, GS, and business partners.
Oversee Business Continuity Management (BCM), including plan approvals, testing, and strategy.
Monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and escalate issues, ensuring alignment with first-line defense (Internal/External Audit).

Vendor Management

Lead the expansion of Vendor Management, optimizing on-shore/off-shore resources and negotiating multi-million-dollar contracts.
Drive cost savings, efficiencies, and service standards across vendor relationships, ensuring alignment with financial and operational targets.

Financial Management & Reporting

Define and execute the Financial Plan for application maintenance, development, and Risk & Governance efforts.
Provide timely, actionable financial reporting (budgets, forecasts, metrics) to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and stakeholders.
Manage IT Development, Maintenance, and Financial budgets, ensuring alignment with annual and 5-year plans.
Oversee project accruals, cost accounting, and vendor invoice management to meet overhead and recovery targets.

Operational Excellence & Performance

Monitor performance metrics, scorecards, and dashboards, driving process improvements and benchmarking.
Lead Program/Project onboarding/closure, ensuring accurate financial tracking in systems (e.g., Planview, MIS).
Leverage AI and automation for reporting and project delivery efficiencies.

People Leadership

Build and mentor a high-performing team, aligning individual goals with RBC’s Leadership Model.
Drive diversity, reward & recognition, and career development initiatives.
Instill a culture of change readiness and empowerment across CPT.

What You Need To Succeed

Must Have:

15+ years of leadership experience in Technology, Financial Services, or Operations, with expertise in Risk, Governance, and Vendor Management.
Proven track record in strategic planning, financial management, and large-scale project delivery.
Strong understanding of AI, Agile/SDLC methodologies, and regulatory compliance.
Exceptional negotiation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or related field; MBA or advanced certification preferred.

Nice to Have:

Payments industry experience

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Opportunities to building close relationships with clients

jobs.description:
Deputy Chief Financial Officer

Prince Rupert, BC
Reference # AC - 7380

Meridia Recruitment Solutions has partnered with the Prince Rupert Port Authority (PRPA) to recruit a Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Deputy CFO) to join their leadership team.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Deputy CFO will provide leadership across accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis, procurement, financial reporting, and capital finance. This role will play a key part in supporting strategic decision-making, overseeing day-to-day financial operations, and ensuring the organization maintains strong financial management, governance, and reporting practices.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes in support of organizational priorities and capital investment plans.
• Prepare financial analysis, business cases, and investment models to support executive and Board decision-making.
• Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, financing arrangements, and banking relationships.
• Provide financial oversight of capital projects and procurement activities, ensuring effective budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls.
• Lead the preparation of accurate and timely IFRS-compliant financial statements and management reporting.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to financial systems, reporting processes, internal controls, and finance operations.
• Coordinate the annual external audit process and ensure compliance with regulatory, taxation, and reporting requirements.
• Prepare materials and reporting for the Executive Leadership Team, Audit Committee, and Board of Directors.
• Partner with leaders across the organization to support budgeting, resource allocation, and operational decision-making.
• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

YOUR REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
• CPA designation required; MBA or other advanced business or finance education considered an asset.
• 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, including 5 years of experience in a senior finance role with responsibility for financial planning, reporting, treasury, and governance.
• Experience supporting Boards of Directors, Audit Committees, and senior executive leadership teams.

KEY SKILLS & CHARACTERISTICS

• Strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, treasury management, internal controls, and financial planning practices.
• Demonstrated success improving finance functions, systems, processes, and reporting capabilities.
• Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills.
• Experience within infrastructure, transportation, marine, logistics, public sector, or other capital-intensive industries would be considered an asset.
• Ability to obtain and maintain Transport Canada Security Clearance.

This is a current vacancy; salary range is $189,000 - $245,000.

For more information, please contact Adam Creaghan, Partner, at acreaghan@kbrs.ca or 647-336-1416 or Lauren MacDonald, Recruitment Specialist, at laurenmacdonald@kbrs.ca or 902-407-1427. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let Lauren know.

jobs.title: Director - Enterprise Data Modernization Lead (GCP)
jobs.description:
Position Description

We are seeking a Director, Consulting Expert (DCE) – Enterprise Data Warehouse & Data Platforms to provide senior technical, solutioning, and client facing leadership

The DCE will serve as a trusted advisor to the client while helping shape, win, govern, and successfully deliver complex enterprise data initiatives.

This is not a narrow technical specialist or delivery only position. The DCE combines deep enterprise data warehouse and modern data platform expertise with consulting acumen, architecture leadership, commercial awareness, and executive presence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior client stakeholders, shaping and estimating solutions, leading architecture decisions, and engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Serve as a senior client facing advisor for enterprise data warehouse, data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization initiatives within a complex telecommunications environment.
Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data strategies, architectures, roadmaps, and solution options.
Lead end to end solution architecture, considering data, applications, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, operations, cost, scalability, and delivery trade offs.
Architect and guide enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, Dataform, and Looker.
Provide technical leadership across enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, metadata, governance, security, and analytics.
Lead or co lead technical solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and account growth opportunities.
Develop and challenge solution scope, architecture, assumptions, estimates, resource models, dependencies, risks, and delivery approaches to ensure solutions are competitive and executable.
Orchestrate SMEs across data, cloud, applications, integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations to develop cohesive end to end solutions.
Lead or participate in architecture, estimation, proposal, and delivery governance reviews, identifying technical and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Advise on AI/ML and generative AI data readiness, including data quality, accessibility, governance, privacy, security, and responsible adoption.
Maintain sufficient hands on technical depth to challenge designs, validate assumptions, troubleshoot critical issues, and defend architectural decisions.
Mentor architects and technical leads and promote reusable architectures, patterns, accelerators, and solution assets across the team.
Partner with the DCS and broader P&L leadership to strengthen the client relationship, identify growth opportunities, improve solution quality, and develop technical leadership capability within the team.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10+ years of progressively responsible experience in leading enterprise data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT consulting disciplines.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex enterprise data warehouse and modern cloud data platform solutions.
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its data and analytics ecosystem, particularly Big Query and associated ingestion, processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics capabilities.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, data quality, metadata, security, governance, and analytics.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data engineering technologies and practices such as Python, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and automated testing/deployment.
Experience with enterprise data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, or comparable platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading solution architecture for significant client engagements, proposals, RFPs, or complex technology pursuits.
Experience developing or validating solution estimates, delivery models, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks.
Strong consulting and executive communication skills, including discovery, problem framing, facilitation, solution development, and client presentations.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, and mentor architects and technical leaders.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI concepts and their implications for enterprise data architecture and governance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience delivering data and analytics solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of large scale, high volume telco data environments and associated business and operational use cases.
Google Cloud certification, particularly Professional Cloud Architect and/or Professional Data Engineer, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience modernizing large legacy or on premises enterprise data warehouse environments to GCP.
Experience within a large IT consulting, systems integration, managed services, or professional services organization.
Experience supporting large, complex and highly integrated enterprise technology environments.
Commercial awareness encompassing consulting economics, solution costing, delivery risk, and value based solutioning.

Leadership Profile

The successful DCE will be a visible, take charge consulting leader who:

Leads with client and business outcomes rather than technology alone.
Has the executive presence to independently lead senior client conversations.
Takes ownership of ambiguous or difficult solution problems and drives them to resolution.
Retains enough hands on technical depth to challenge and defend important architecture decisions.
Challenges unrealistic estimates, unsupported assumptions, scope gaps, and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Works across organizational and technology boundaries rather than operating as a narrow or isolated SME.
Coaches and develops architects and technical leaders, raising the capability of the broader team.

Measures of Success

Success will be reflected in stronger client relationships, higher quality solutions and estimates, improved pursuit outcomes, reduced delivery risk, successful enterprise data initiatives, and increased technical capability across the team.

The DCE will be recognized by the client, delivery teams, DCS, and broader P&L leadership as a trusted senior advisor who connects telecommunications business outcomes, enterprise data architecture, technology, commercial realities, and delivery feasibility.

new_jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource-library/customer-stories

Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
Employees receive 25 days of paid time off per year. After 5 years of employment, employees receive 30 days per year.
Appfire provides comprehensive coverage through Empire Health, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Additional protection includes life insurance, critical illness coverage, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
To promote health and well-being, Appfire offers a yearly sport allowance of CAD 600, which can be used to cover the cost of various fitness or outdoor activities from gym memberships to sports equipment.
Volunteering - Every employee receives 3 fully paid days each year to participate in Appfire Town, our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program supporting local communities.

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Position Description

We are seeking a Director, Consulting Expert (DCE) – Enterprise Data Warehouse & Data Platforms to provide senior technical, solutioning, and client facing leadership

The DCE will serve as a trusted advisor to the client while helping shape, win, govern, and successfully deliver complex enterprise data initiatives.

This is not a narrow technical specialist or delivery only position. The DCE combines deep enterprise data warehouse and modern data platform expertise with consulting acumen, architecture leadership, commercial awareness, and executive presence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior client stakeholders, shaping and estimating solutions, leading architecture decisions, and engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Serve as a senior client facing advisor for enterprise data warehouse, data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization initiatives within a complex telecommunications environment.
Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data strategies, architectures, roadmaps, and solution options.
Lead end to end solution architecture, considering data, applications, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, operations, cost, scalability, and delivery trade offs.
Architect and guide enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, Dataform, and Looker.
Provide technical leadership across enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, metadata, governance, security, and analytics.
Lead or co lead technical solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and account growth opportunities.
Develop and challenge solution scope, architecture, assumptions, estimates, resource models, dependencies, risks, and delivery approaches to ensure solutions are competitive and executable.
Orchestrate SMEs across data, cloud, applications, integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations to develop cohesive end to end solutions.
Lead or participate in architecture, estimation, proposal, and delivery governance reviews, identifying technical and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Advise on AI/ML and generative AI data readiness, including data quality, accessibility, governance, privacy, security, and responsible adoption.
Maintain sufficient hands on technical depth to challenge designs, validate assumptions, troubleshoot critical issues, and defend architectural decisions.
Mentor architects and technical leads and promote reusable architectures, patterns, accelerators, and solution assets across the team.
Partner with the DCS and broader P&L leadership to strengthen the client relationship, identify growth opportunities, improve solution quality, and develop technical leadership capability within the team.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10+ years of progressively responsible experience in leading enterprise data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT consulting disciplines.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex enterprise data warehouse and modern cloud data platform solutions.
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its data and analytics ecosystem, particularly Big Query and associated ingestion, processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics capabilities.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, data quality, metadata, security, governance, and analytics.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data engineering technologies and practices such as Python, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and automated testing/deployment.
Experience with enterprise data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, or comparable platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading solution architecture for significant client engagements, proposals, RFPs, or complex technology pursuits.
Experience developing or validating solution estimates, delivery models, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks.
Strong consulting and executive communication skills, including discovery, problem framing, facilitation, solution development, and client presentations.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, and mentor architects and technical leaders.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI concepts and their implications for enterprise data architecture and governance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience delivering data and analytics solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of large scale, high volume telco data environments and associated business and operational use cases.
Google Cloud certification, particularly Professional Cloud Architect and/or Professional Data Engineer, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience modernizing large legacy or on premises enterprise data warehouse environments to GCP.
Experience within a large IT consulting, systems integration, managed services, or professional services organization.
Experience supporting large, complex and highly integrated enterprise technology environments.
Commercial awareness encompassing consulting economics, solution costing, delivery risk, and value based solutioning.

Leadership Profile

The successful DCE will be a visible, take charge consulting leader who:

Leads with client and business outcomes rather than technology alone.
Has the executive presence to independently lead senior client conversations.
Takes ownership of ambiguous or difficult solution problems and drives them to resolution.
Retains enough hands on technical depth to challenge and defend important architecture decisions.
Challenges unrealistic estimates, unsupported assumptions, scope gaps, and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Works across organizational and technology boundaries rather than operating as a narrow or isolated SME.
Coaches and develops architects and technical leaders, raising the capability of the broader team.

Measures of Success

Success will be reflected in stronger client relationships, higher quality solutions and estimates, improved pursuit outcomes, reduced delivery risk, successful enterprise data initiatives, and increased technical capability across the team.

The DCE will be recognized by the client, delivery teams, DCS, and broader P&L leadership as a trusted senior advisor who connects telecommunications business outcomes, enterprise data architecture, technology, commercial realities, and delivery feasibility.
